abilities.name: Grounded task intake
abilities.active_when: Goal, scope, constraints, target, and missing fields are resolved or explicitly clarified.
abilities.owner_next_action: Provide the one missing field shown by Mission Control.

abilities.name: Bounded workflow planning
abilities.active_when: A versioned workflow records allowed tools, stop condition, budget, and approval boundary.
abilities.owner_next_action: Review the selected workflow and approve only the declared external effect.

abilities.name: Local work execution
abilities.active_when: Project, local diagnosis, and Coding maintenance complete through canonical Runtime.
abilities.owner_next_action: Run one bounded local workflow from normal Chat or Agent mode.

abilities.name: Browser and external action
abilities.active_when: A bounded browser flow and an approved GitHub write have current successful evidence.
abilities.owner_next_action: Approve the bounded browser or GitHub target shown in Mission Control.

abilities.name: Durable recovery
abilities.active_when: Restart, retry, resume, revise, and cancel preserve history without repeating completed effects.
abilities.owner_next_action: Use the displayed resume, retry, revise, or cancel action on the same run.

abilities.name: Verified delivery
abilities.active_when: Every success claim links to its required receipt, artifact, check, or external evidence.
abilities.owner_next_action: Open the evidence link beside the final result.

abilities.name: Proactive delivery
abilities.active_when: One fresh scheduled GitHub signal reaches Telegram exactly once and links to its source event.
abilities.owner_next_action: Connect GitHub and Telegram when Mission Control reports setup needed.
